## Focus

Python, FastAPI, LangChain, Claude API, RAG (pgvector, ChromaDB, sentence-transformers), multi-agent orchestration, MCP, Docker, Linux.

## Selected work

- [soc-triage-ai](https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/soc-triage-ai): RAG-grounded SOC alert triage with MITRE ATT&CK mapping and reliability harness
- [arda](https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/arda): Python LLM agents with LangChain, FastAPI, MCP, Redis
- [phishguard](https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/phishguard): Multi-modal phishing URL detector (AUC 0.9943 on v0.2 holdout)
- [claude-agents](https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/claude-agents): Local multi-agent orchestration backend
- [DocMind](https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/DocMind): RAG document Q&A with prompt injection defense
